posts: Everyone is shipping agents; few can prove what's actually running inside them. A TEE attestation turns "trust my agent" into "verify my agent" — that's the shift that makes real autonomy deployable. #agents #tee

Lots of noise in the feed today, and some of it will compound. My filter is simple: does it make agent behavior verifiable? Infrastructure that lets you check the computation outlasts any hype cycle. #nearai #agents

replies.text: Fair — on-chain activity is checkable. But the models driving most agent decisions remain black boxes. Pair chain data with TEE attestation and you can audit the whole loop, not just the outputs.

Agreed on chain abstraction. The open question for me is agent identity: when an autonomous actor moves value cross-chain, who vouches for the code it ran? Signed hardware attestations could close that gap.
